question: For the [TEPAH][ATA]/NPA/H2O phase change absorbent at the optimal desorption conditions, what regeneration efficiency was reached, and after five absorption-desorption cycles what remained?
expect: 94.7% at 393.15 K and 80 min; 88.6% of the initial value after five cycles (sec. 3.2)
rendered:
The document titled "Amino-Functionalized Ionic Liquid Phase Change Absorbents for Efficient CO2 Capture" provides the answer to the question.

At the optimal regeneration conditions, which were established as a desorption temperature of 393.15 K and a duration of 80 min, the rich phase was regenerated efficiently, with a regeneration efficiency of 94.7%.

After five absorption-desorption cycles, the regeneration efficiency remained at 88.6% of its initial value, indicating that the absorbent maintains good stability after repeated regeneration.
